After one month of using the OnePlus 15, I can honestly say I’m extremely satisfied with this phone. 
 
The battery life is outstanding — it easily lasts through a full day of heavy use. Even when using navigation while driving with music playing, it only drains about 7–8% per hour, which is impressive. Combined with the original 120W charger, the experience is next level — I plug it in in the morning while getting ready, and by the time I’m done, it’s fully charged and ready for the entire day. 
 
Performance is flawless. Everything runs fast and smooth with zero lag. The display is beautiful, with vibrant colors and excellent clarity. Sound quality is also top-notch — the speakers are great, and audio output to external devices via cable or Bluetooth is perfect. 
 
The UI is very intuitive, especially coming from Xiaomi. Everything feels clean, fast, and easy to navigate. One feature that truly stands out is the privacy system for hidden apps — it’s the best I’ve ever seen. It’s incredibly well designed, secure, and feels complete with no gaps. 
 
The phone is also very comfortable to use — great size, great in-hand feel. I highly recommend using original cases — I have all three, and each one is useful and comfortable in different situations. 
 
This is the first time I’ve bought a phone where nothing annoys me and nothing feels missing. In fact, it keeps surprising me in a positive way. 
 
The camera is excellent. Photography enthusiasts might want more, but for everyday users like me — photos, videos, selfies, document scanning, and AI editing — it is more than enough and definitely at a flagship level. 
 
I highly recommend anyone considering a new phone to seriously take a look at the OnePlus 15.
